reviews.text: I talked to these guys about installing a remote start for my wife's car.  When I carried it to them, they showed me that it was already installed and how to use it.  Their honesty saved me $600. This is hard to find in a company today.  I will be back for sure with other business.
reviews.author: Justin Hewlett

reviews.text: I have been Shopping around for a professional install and this is it Lone Star Audio Sound and security..the best in the business
reviews.author: Davy Hemmings

reviews.text: Lonestar auto and sound is a great place. No need to look anywhere else for better prices Mike the owner has stereos at all price points. My stereo  installed in 30 mins. Great customer service.  Owner mike has 30yrs in the business.
reviews.author: Michael Benavides

reviews.text: They do good work. I have had zero issues over the last 6 years of going here. 3 different vehicles done, from tint, to audio to security. I will be bringing my new car there soon to get windows done! But more than likely after the holidays. It stays busy this time of year.
reviews.author: Stefani St. Clare

reviews.text: Mike is honest and doesn't mess around. He has been in business forever and has great experience / knowledge. I've been going to him for years, and will continue to do so. He and his staff are a great resource and have handled my few problems over the years quickly. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Chris Scotto

reviews.text: These guys are the absolute best. They will do anything to make sure you are taken care of. You need an outstanding tint job? they will do it and garauntee it for 2 years. You need a system put in your car and it done RIGHT? They will do it. If you need them to keep your car in their place for a couple nights because you can’t get their before they close? They will do it. They are just the best.
reviews.author: Audrey Carter

reviews.text: I was a bit disappointed with the customer service. Made an appointment for window tint at 9:30am thinking my vehicle would be worked on around that time. Before I left I had asked about how long it would be, I got a response of "I don't know." So I assume 3 hours should be long enough. 4 hours later I start to wonder what is taking so long, decide to drive by and check it out. Well my vehicle was still parked in the same spot I had left it in, 4 hours later and still had not even been started on. Got my keys and left.
reviews.author: Rafael Sandoval

reviews.text: Great service, and very professional.  The owner came out and conversed with me while my truck was being serviced.  I enjoyed the conversation and the work was fantastic.  Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: roderick bryant

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic, reflecting a long-established business (32 years) with a generally positive reputation. The lower Yelp rating and specific complaint about scheduling suggest a potential weakness in customer service/communication, but not fraud. The detailed, credible stories in the positive reviews outweigh concerns about low volume and age.
fake_signals: Some reviews are very old (7-10 years)
Low total review volume across platforms
authentic_signals: Specific, believable anecdotes (e.g., saved $600, remote start already installed)
Owner's name (Mike) and experience mentioned consistently
Mix of praise and specific constructive feedback
